findings.claim: `zip(error_ids, events.values())` assumes `nodestore.get_multi` keeps input order with no gaps, so error ids can be paired with the wrong event's title, message and timestamp.
findings.evidence: get_multi dedupes ids, returns fetched items before cached ones (`items.update(cache_items)`, src/sentry/nodestore/base.py:184-205), and can omit missing ids. open-code-review red test: store events A and B, warm the cache for A only, call fetch_error_details(project.id, [A, B]); A's entry gets B's title. superpowers notes the id is not used in the log text today, so the impact may be latent. Reasoned, not executed.
findings.reason: Accepted. Three seats agree. open-code-review supplied the red test (partial cache warm). Severity is normalised to Important (open-code-review Important; superpowers Minor).

findings.claim: A report with neither `age` nor `timestamp` passes validation, although the validators' docstrings say one of them must be present.

findings.reason: Accepted. Three seats agree. The fix is the same object-level `validate` as the truthiness finding.

findings.reason: Appendix (2 seats). Not fixed under the agreement rule, despite the executed red repro. Flagged as the strongest appendix candidate for a human to promote.
